column1: # XIIOnline co-op support ledger, read by the dashboard's Player progression tab (OPUS, 2026-09-30).
# One row per piece of game content whose co-op behaviour has been checked. The tab shows a family's co-op percentage
# only when the family has rows here; with none it shows "—" (unmeasured), never zero.
# family: a Player progression family id (world, story, party, licences, abilities, commands, gambits, statuses,
# key:    the catalogue key (for example enemy:bds_a:3, or a map code such as rbn_z01 for the world)
# evidence: the test, log or commit that shows it
